name: Traditional balsamic vinegar
about: A dark, syrupy vinegar made from cooked grape must and aged in wooden barrels. It is a specialty of the Emilia-Romagna region, where Bologna is the capital.
tip: Look for the Tradizionale DOP label, and choose the 12-year grade for the best quality.

name: Parmigiano Reggiano
where: Tamburini or cheese shops in the Quadrilatero
about: A hard, aged cheese with a protected DOP origin, made in Emilia-Romagna. Bologna's markets and delis are famous for selling it.
tip: Check that it is vacuum-sealed and ask how to store it so it stays fresh on the trip home.
